Control Description: Production changes require documented approval before implementation
Test Objective: Determine whether production changes were authorized before implementation
Audit Procedure: Select production changes and compare approval timestamps with deployment timestamps
Evidence Reviewed: Change tickets; approval records; deployment logs
Auditor Conclusion: All sampled production changes had documented approval before implementation.

Control Description: Changes undergo documented testing and review before production deployment
Test Objective: Determine whether changes were adequately tested before release
Audit Procedure: Inspect sampled change records for test plans test results and evidence of review before deployment
Evidence Reviewed: Test plans; test results; change tickets; deployment records
Exception Identified: Two sampled changes lacked documented evidence of completed testing before deployment.
Auditor Conclusion: The control did not operate effectively for the samples tested. Further investigation is required to determine the impact of the exceptions.

Control Description: Production deployment permissions are restricted to authorized personnel
Test Objective: Determine whether production deployment privileges are appropriately restricted and reviewed
Audit Procedure: Inspect deployment access listings and verify that permissions are approved and periodically reviewed
Population: 15 personnel with production deployment access as of December 31, 2025
Evidence Reviewed: Deployment access listings; permission configurations; quarterly review records
Auditor Conclusion: All sampled deployment accounts were authorized and supported by documented review evidence.

Control Description: Emergency changes are documented and reviewed after implementation
Test Objective: Determine whether emergency changes receive appropriate justification and retrospective review
Audit Procedure: Select emergency changes and inspect justification and post-implementation review evidence
Evidence Reviewed: Emergency change tickets; justification records; post-implementation review evidence
Exception Identified: One sampled emergency change lacked documented retrospective review.
Auditor Conclusion: The control did not operate effectively for the sample tested because one emergency change lacked evidence of retrospective review.
